title: Brent spike leads INDA lower 1-2d
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Brent single-day log return > 3 pct leads India ETF returns lower by 1-2 days (-); trade short INDA 2d [finance.BZ=F.log_return -> finance.INDA.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.BZ=F.log_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short INDA next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Brent absolute daily return spikes lead India ETF realized range higher by 1-2 days (+); trade long INDA straddle-proxy 2d [finance.BZ=F.abs_return -> finance.INDA.range_pct] (parent: R2-0096)
